_readme: The supporter rules the apps show (Profile → Supporter rules, and the application form). Served in GET /config as supporter_rules; the app shows these when present and its own built-in copy when not, so the rules can change after a legal review without an app release.
icon: one of hand, door, shield, footprints, ban. An unknown name shows a neutral icon ("message" is one until the app learns it).
Keep them in step with the scope rules (llm/playbooks.json): a rule here that the assistant would still book is a promise we break.

items.title: You can always say no
items.body: Decline any task, or leave one, if you feel unsafe. There's no penalty, and you don't have to explain.

items.title: Can't finish? Tell us right away
items.body: If you can't start or finish a task you accepted, message HO:RA straight away so we can find someone else. How the time you logged is handled depends on what happened, so tell us and we'll work it out with you. If you feel unsafe, leave first and tell us after.

items.title: Homes only for a specific errand
items.body: Go inside a home only for the errand you accepted, with the customer or an adult they named present, or with clear access instructions from them.

items.title: Never alone with minors
items.body: If you would be left alone with someone under 18, stop and leave the task.

items.title: Never drive a customer
items.body: Never give anyone a ride. You can use your own car to carry items when the task says so.

items.title: No alcohol, tobacco, drugs or prescriptions
items.body: Never buy, carry or deliver alcohol, tobacco, vapes, cannabis or illegal drugs, even if the customer asks. At a pharmacy, over-the-counter items only: never pick up a prescription.
